items.claim: Offset's distance resets when the popover closes or the asset moves
items.note: `OffsetSlider` resets its distance to `DISTANCE.default` after every commit on purpose: the new outline is selected, so the next offset starts from it (`PathCommands.tsx`, the `onChange` comment). A drag or a key step commits, so the slider shows the default on reopening whether or not the popover kept its state.

items.claim: `useEditorSurfaceHost`'s memo misses on every render because `setSimplifyTolerance` is a new function each time
items.note: (`useSimplifyTolerance`'s setter is now a `useCallback` over the stable `values`).

items.claim: A command-row asset hidden from its panel's × has no View-menu toggle to bring it back
items.note: I made the strict call: a command-row asset's panel has no hide button, and it is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round thirty-five". It applies to the whole command row, Undo and File included, not only `pathCommands` and `fillets`. Listing those assets in the View menu was the alternative.
